# Topic Cluster

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Notes and artifacts assembled around a single topic, rather than every note that happens to mention it.

## Scope note

Gathers the notes of one topic. Unlike the time clusters it asserts no partitive structure yet, so its members are related by skos:broader alone.
